s: ka Na vijYApe । vijYAne । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (curAM-AtmaM-sakaM-sew .) vijYApo vijYApanam । ka Na, gArayate sUkzmamarTaM suDIH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
gi Sabde । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (kyrAM-paraMsakaM-sew .) Sabda iha vyaktavAkyam । gi, gFRAti vAkyaM lokaH । gIrRaH gIrRiH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥

Sa nigaraRe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (tudAM-paraMsakaM-sew .) nigaraRaM BakzaRam । Sa, giratyannaM lokaH । dEvAttato vigalito gilito vakena iti tu asmAt kfdDoH kaBAve iti BAve kapratyaye fdiraRAviti iri vaktavyAdrePasya lakAre gila iti sTite leH kftyAKyAne iti YO karmmaRi kte, sidDam । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
v: vijYApane curA॰ Atma॰ saka॰ sew । gArayate ajIgarat ।

Sabde kryAdi॰ para॰ pvAdi॰ saka॰ sew । gfRAti agArIta jagAra jagaratuH । gIryyate gIrRaH । gIH । anu + SaMsanavizayaharzAnukUlavyApArarUpaprotsAhane tadyoge pUrvavyApAraRasya karttA saMpradAnasaMjYo Bavati yaTA aDaryyuH hotre anugfRAti hotA praTamaM SaMsati tamaDvaryuH protsAhayatItyarTaH si॰ kO॰ prati + anugfRAtivat arTAdi asyAvapUrvaprayogo nAsti iti “avAdgraH” pA॰ sUtre BAzyakAra Aha sma

nigaraRe tu॰ para॰ saka॰ sew । asya vA rasya latvam girati--gilati agArIt agAlIt jagAra (la) । jagaratuH । gIryate gIrRaH gIrRiH giraH giriH ava + nIcEHkaTane Atma॰ avagirate nIcEH kaTayatItyarTaH । ud + vamane । “romanTaH udgIrya carvaRam” si॰ kO॰ “anudgIrRasurAyuDam” kumA॰ । sam + pratijYAyAm Atma॰ । saMgirate pratijAnIte ityarTaH । “basUni deSAMSca nivarttayizyan rAmaM nfpaH saMgiramARa eva” BawwiH ।
m: 1. गॄ cl. 9. P. Ā. गृणाति, ˚णीते (1. sg. Ā. and 3. sg. Pass. गृणे, RV.; 1. sg. Ā. गृणीषे, RV.; 2. pl. गृणता, AV. v, 27, 9; p. P. गृणत्, RV. &c.; Ā. & Pass. गृणान, RV.; Ved. inf. Impv. गृणीषणि, RV. vi, 15, 6 and viii, 12, 19), to call, call out to, invoke, RV.; AV.; ŚBr. iv; Bhag. xi, 21; to announce, proclaim, RV.; to mention with praise, praise, extol, RV.; BhP. xi, 13, 41; Bhaṭṭ. viii, 77; to pronounce, recite, MBh. vii, 1754; Ragh.; BhP. i, 1, 14; to relate, teach in verses, 4, 9; Gaṇit. i, 4, 5;
गॄ [cf. γηρύω, γλῶσσα; Hib. goirim; Old Germ. quar, quir, &c.; Old Pruss. gerbu, ‘to speak’; Angl.Sax. gale; Germ. Nachtigal; Lat. gallus ?]

2. गॄ cl. 6. P. गिरति or (cf. Pāṇ. viii, 2, 21) गिलति (ŚBr. i; MBh.; Suśr.), ep. also Ā. गिरते (1. sg. गिरामि, AV. vi, 135, 3; perf. जगार, RV.; aor. Subj. 3. pl. गरन्, RV. i, 158, 5), to swallow, devour, eat, RV. &c.; to emit or eject from the mouth, MBh. xii, 12872 : Caus. (aor. 2. sg. अजीगर्) to swallow, RV. i, 163, 7 : Intens. जेगिल्यते, Pāṇ. viii, 2, 20 : Desid. जिगरिषति, vii, 2, 75;
गॄ [cf. √ 2. गल्, 2. गिर्, गिल, 2. गीर्ण; Lith. gerru, ‘to drink’; Lat. glu-tio, gula; Slav. gr-lo; Russ. žora.]
3. गॄ (= √ 3. कॄ) cl. 10. Ā. गारयते, to know, Dhātup. xxxiii, 33; to make known, teach, ib.
a: गॄ — {vI.v} {c9c} P. (गृणाति, गूर्ण) 1 To utter a sound, call out, invoke, नामापि नाम गृणताममृतत्वाय कल्पतां Mv. 7. 15. --2 To announce, speak, utter, proclaim; R. 10. 63. --3 To relate, promulgate. --4 To praise, extol; केचिद्धीताः प्रांजलयो गृणंति Bg. 11. 21; Bk. 8. 77. --WITH अनु to encourage; Bk. 8. 77. {vII.v} {c6c} P. (गिरति or गिलति) 1 To swallow, devour, eat up. --2 To send forth, pour out, spit out, or eject, from the mouth. --WITH अव (Atm.) to eat, devour; तथावगिरमाणैश्च पिशाचैर्मांसशोणितं Bk. 8. 30. {vIII.v} {c10c} A. (गारयते) 1 To make known, relate. --2 To teach.
